rules.title: Tax rules
rules.intro: Prices are tax-inclusive, so a rule never changes an order total; it only shows the tax inside it on invoices. Only one rule can be active.
rules.codeHint: A short unique code such as VAT15. It cannot be changed later.
rules.name: Name
rules.inclusiveNote: Tax is always included in the price. Tax added on top is not supported.
rules.deliveryLabel: Tax applies to the delivery charge
rules.deliveryHint: Includes the share of tax inside the delivery charge on invoices.
rules.verifiedHint: Leave this off until the rate has been confirmed.
rules.activateText: Orders placed from now on carry {name} ({rate}%). Any other active rule is switched off. Orders placed before keep no tax.
rules.unverifiedText: The rate has not been confirmed with an accountant. Invoices would show tax figures that may be wrong.
rules.acknowledge: I know this rule is not verified and I want to use it.
rules.deactivateText: New orders will carry no tax until a rule is active again. Existing invoices do not change.
